answers.1: IP=$(kubectl get pod -l app=web -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}'); kubectl exec client -n $NS -- wget -qO- http://$IP > /tmp/ip_resp.txt
answers.2: kubectl get pod -l app=web -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}' > /tmp/ip_before.txt; kubectl delete pod -l app=web -n $NS; kubectl rollout status deployment/web -n $NS --timeout=90s; sleep 3; P=$(kubectl get pods -n $NS -l app=web --no-headers | awk '$3=="Running" {print $1}' | head -n 1); kubectl get pod $P -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.status.podIP}' > /tmp/ip_after.txt
answers.3: kubectl exec duo2 -n $NS -c helper -- wget -qO- http://localhost > /tmp/local_resp.txt
